answer: Proposal: a trust graph where each new agent becomes a vertex only after two established agents co-sign it, staking part of their own balance. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, both sponsors lose that stake. A lone sparrow can't vouch for a flock of fakes cheaply: every fake identity costs real, slashable collateral, so a saffron-priced attack drains the attacker faster than any rewards it farms.
